contract.name: CalculateDensity
contract.description:
Calculate static periodic-cell mass density with complete source provenance.

Args:
    file_name: Existing periodic structure file supported by pymatgen,
        such as CIF or POSCAR; absolute path or task attachment name.
        The supplied cell must have finite positive volume and mass.

Returns:
    density_g_per_cm3, mass_u and volume_angstrom_cubed as unrounded finite
    numbers; sites, formula, source_file, source_sha256 and method. Density
    uses occupancy-weighted cell mass and the supplied cell volume. It is
    not a measured bulk/powder density, porosity estimate or relaxed state.

Raises:
    FileNotFoundError: Missing source file.
    ValueError: Unreadable structure, nonpositive/nonfinite volume or mass,
        or a source file that changes while it is being read. No error is
        returned as a successful density observation.

contract.name: CrystalStructureMatch

contract.name: FinitePopulationCoverage
contract.description: Compute hypergeometric zero-hit probabilities and expected observed-feature coverage under uniform sampling without replacement from an explicit finite population. Feature overlaps are allowed; no unseen-feature estimate or inference is provided.
contract.call_signature: FinitePopulationCoverage(population_size: int, feature_success_counts: list, sample_sizes: list) -> dict

parameters.name: population_size
parameters.description: Number N of exchangeable sampling units in the declared finite population,integer0..1e9. This is not inferred from sum(featurecounts),because features may overlap. Mathematically integral JSON numbers are accepted without loss;fractions,booleans and strings are rejected.

parameters.name: feature_success_counts
parameters.description: Ordered counts K of units carrying each feature;everyinteger0<=K<=N. Zero features retained. Categories may overlap;caller establishes the scientific meaning. Mathematically integral JSON numbers are accepted without loss;fractions,booleans and strings are rejected.

parameters.name: sample_sizes
parameters.description: Ordered draw sizes m,integer0<=m<=N,uniform without replacement. Duplicates retained. Featurecount*drawcount<=10000;total exact log-product work<=2million. Mathematically integral JSON numbers are accepted without loss;fractions,booleans and strings are rejected.

contract.output_description:
Expected distinct features encountered in a uniform sample without replacement.

population_size is an integer number of exchangeable sampling units,0..1e9.
Each integer feature_success_counts[k] is the number of those units carrying
feature k,0..population_size. Features may overlap: the expectation uses
linearity and does not assume mutual independence or mutually exclusive
categories. Caller must establish the actual scientific sampling unit.

sample_sizes contains integer draws,each0..population_size;its order and
duplicates are retained. Both lists have1..1000entries and their product is
at most10000. At most2000000log-product terms are evaluated per call.
Mathematically integral finite JSON numbers such as448.0 are accepted and
converted without loss to integers;fractions,booleans and strings reject.

For a feature present in K of N units and draw m,the probability of no hit is
C(N-K,m)/C(N,m). Zero and certain-hit boundaries are evaluated exactly. Other
cases use a finite log1p product with min(K,m) terms and -expm1(logP) for
stable tiny hit probabilities. No simulation,normal approximation or silent
probability clipping is used. This is the hypergeometric zero-hit formula.

Returns population/feature counts and ordered analyses. Every analysis has
sample_size,sample_fraction(null if N=0),feature_absence_probabilities in the
original feature order,expected_detected_features,and
expected_fraction_of_observed_features(null if every feature count is0).
Expected values are finite real numbers,not rounded observed counts.

This computes an expectation conditional on the supplied finite population
and uniform sampling model. It provides no confidence interval,p-value,
unseen-feature estimate,detection correction,spatial independence proof,
extrapolation beyond N,or guarantee of population representativeness.

contract.name: FitBulkRNASeqCounts
contract.description: Fit a PyDESeq2 negative-binomial bulk RNA-seq count model with explicit design factors/contrast and sample-ID mapping. Uses nonnegative integer gene-by-sample counts, matched metadata, declared Cook filtering and model-resource versions. This is a fitted count-model analysis, distinct from generic p-value adjustment or enrichment; cache identity includes data/model settings.
contract.call_signature: FitBulkRNASeqCounts(counts_file: str, metadata_file: str, design_factors: list[str], contrast: list[str], sample_id_column: str='sample_id', gene_id_column: str='gene_id', metadata_id_suffix: str='', sample_subset: list[str] | None=None, fit_type: str='parametric', cooks_filter: bool=True, use_cache: bool=True) -> dict

parameters.name: counts_file
parameters.description: Uploaded/public UTF-8 TSV, gene rows; gene_id_column is the identity field and every other column is raw nonnegative integer sample counts. All rows are fitted, no gene preselection. <=50MiB,60000genes64samples2millioncells.

parameters.name: metadata_file
parameters.description: Uploaded/public UTF-8 CSV, one unique sample per row. Its complete sample identities must match count columns exactly before optional sample subsetting. <=50MiB.

parameters.name: design_factors
parameters.description: 1..6 unique categorical metadata columns for additive intercept-plus-factor effects. Each factor must vary, categorical coding must be full rank with >=2 residual degrees of freedom. No continuous covariates/interactions/random effects. Additive factor order has no scientific meaning and is lexically canonicalized before coding/fitting/cache identity.

parameters.name: contrast
parameters.description: Exactly [factor,tested_level,reference_level]; the signed log2 fold change is tested/reference. Factor must be in design and each contrasted level must have >=2 fitted samples.

parameters.name: sample_id_column
parameters.description: Metadata column containing exact sample identities, default sample_id. Cannot be a design factor.

parameters.name: gene_id_column
parameters.description: Count TSV column containing unique nonempty gene identities, default gene_id; all other columns are sample counts.

parameters.name: metadata_id_suffix
parameters.description: Explicit suffix required on every metadata sample ID, then removed exactly once for matching count sample IDs. Empty preserves exact IDs. No implicit name cleanup.

parameters.name: sample_subset
parameters.description: Null fits all count samples. Otherwise >=4 unique exact count sample IDs, canonicalized to original column order; all input genes remain in the fitting universe.

parameters.name: fit_type
parameters.description: Requested PyDESeq2 dispersion trend parametric(default) or mean. Actual fallback and warnings are returned, never hidden.

parameters.name: cooks_filter
parameters.description: Apply library Cook distance p-value filtering, default true. Count replacement remains false and independent filtering remains false regardless.

Fit one declared fixed curve family using bounded local least squares.

parameters, at most1000 observations, and observations must exceed parameter
count. Duplicate x observations are allowed; at least2 distinct x are needed.

robust losses, nonconvergence or deficient rank return null covariance/SE.

contract.name: GetStructureByMaterialId
contract.description:
Get one final core crystal structure for a single Materials Project ID.

Queries only the official materials/core endpoint; this is its current
final material structure, not necessarily the geometry of another property
calculation or a surface slab. Legacy numeric mp-/mvc- IDs and current
eight-letter mp- IDs are accepted. Aliases are reported as requested and
resolved IDs. No fallback to another property endpoint is performed.
Args:
    material_id (str): One bare legal material ID; no list, formula or query.
Returns:
    dict: Complete original Structure JSON (all species and occupancies
    retained), resolved/requested material IDs, source hash and provenance. Cell
    lengths/angles/volume and fractional/Cartesian coordinates are checked
    with roundoff tolerances. Site coordinates may differ by integer cell
    images only along periodic axes (pbc defaults to all true if absent).
    Missing, ambiguous, malformed, authorization or HTTP responses raise
    explicit exceptions; no None or fabricated structure is returned.

contract.name: MatchedPeriodicDisplacements
contract.description:
Return minimum-image displacements for fixed same-index crystal sites.

CIF fractional positions are preserved without rational-coordinate snapping.

Both explicitly uploaded ordered structures must contain the same species
sequence, 1..256 sites and a common cell (absolute entry tolerance 1e-8 A).
No atom permutation, rigid alignment, strain removal or trajectory unwrapping
is performed. Cell rows are lattice vectors. For atom i displacement is
mobile_cart[i] + image_shift[i] @ reference_cell - reference_cart[i].
Fractional source coordinates must be finite with abs<=1e6. Volume>=1e-8 A^3
and perpendicular cell heights>=1e-5 A are required. Exact reciprocal-height
bounds enumerate at most 1e6 total image candidates; exceeding this rejects
the entire call before enumeration. No [-1,1] assumption is made for skew

not infer diffusion, atomic identity correspondence, or a physical pathway.

contract.name: MolecularElectronicDescriptors
contract.description: Compute selected RDKit electronic features from exactly one SMILES or CSV source. Supply exactly one of smiles or csv_file; CSV requires explicit SMILES columns. Both transports use the same named descriptors and scientific settings. CSV preserves source fields, zero-based row identity, selected names, SHA256 provenance and indexed invalid-cell errors in a new streamed artifact. Repeated exact SMILES are computed once per call. Invalid cells fail by default; invalid_policy=record writes null with an indexed error. Limits:10000 transformed cells,16 columns,25 MiB input,128 MiB output. Inline input rejects columns and nondefault invalid_policy. No imputation, training, response selection or scientific workflow is performed. Default names: MaxEStateIndex, MinAbsEStateIndex, MinEStateIndex, qed, NumValenceElectrons, NumRadicalElectrons, MaxPartialCharge, MinPartialCharge, MaxAbsPartialCharge, MinAbsPartialCharge, MolLogP and MolMR. descriptors may select a unique nonempty subset. One parsed hydrogen-suppressed molecule shares EState extrema, Wildman-Crippen logP/MR and one12-iteration Gasteiger charge assignment; missing parameters and nonfinite values fail. MinAbsPartialCharge follows RDKit's named descriptor: the smaller absolute signed minimum/maximum charge, not the minimum over every atom. QED is a model-defined composite, not measured drug-likeness. These features do not estimate experimental charge, activity or partition measurements.

contract.name: MolecularFingerprint
contract.description: Calculate molecular fingerprints from exactly one SMILES or explicit CSV source. Algorithms: morgan, rdkit (path), atom_pair, torsion, maccs, avalon, pharm2d, mhfp, secfp, tautomer_target. options accepts only algorithm-specific keys, rejecting irrelevant settings. Morgan defaults radius2/2048 bits; rdkit defaults 2048 bits/path1-7/2 bits per hash/use_hs true/no density folding. atom_pair defaults un-hashed counts; presence must be explicit. Outputs use full sparse indices/counts or minhash values, never abbreviated NumPy text. No salt/tautomer/stereo normalization is applied; removable H are suppressed. Supply exactly one of smiles or csv_file. CSV requires 1-16 named SMILES columns; source fields, zero-based row identity, SHA256 provenance and full JSON fingerprint cells are preserved in a new streamed artifact. Exact repeated SMILES are computed once per CSV call. invalid_policy=error fails and removes a partial artifact; record writes null and indexed errors for invalid cells. Limits are 10000 transformed cells, 25 MiB input and128 MiB output. Inline mode rejects columns and nondefault invalid_policy. No model training, feature selection, response selection or scientific workflow is run.

contract.name: NeEMO
contract.description: Submit or resume public NeEMO structure preparation and optional mutation stability jobs. Top-level status is queued until the structure and every requested mutation job finish, then completed; queued results are pending work, not completed predictions. Only parsed completed mutation tables supply kcal/mol stability changes. When the structure job is queued, local preparation from the first PDB model reports isolated-chain Shrake-Rupley absolute ASA in angstrom^2, distinct from NeEMO relative accessibility percent. No stability change is estimated locally. The same mutation and settings reuse the stored PID.

contract.name: PairwiseNumericDistances
contract.description: Compute a complete pairwise distance matrix on unchanged ordered feature rows using one declared metric. Preserve zero-vector and unit policies; perform no alignment, clustering or representative selection.
contract.call_signature: PairwiseNumericDistances(values: list, other: list | None=None, metric: str='euclidean') -> dict

parameters.name: values
parameters.description: Finite rectangular nonempty numeric feature rows; at most 10000 total input cells. Boolean, null and ragged rows are rejected. Row order is preserved; feature units and column order must agree.

parameters.name: other
parameters.description: Null compares values with itself; otherwise provide a finite matrix with the same feature width. Total input cells and output row-count product are each at most 10000. Matrix columns correspond to rows of other in their original order.

parameters.name: metric
parameters.description: Exactly euclidean, cityblock, cosine, braycurtis or jaccard. No implicit scaling or binarization. Cosine rejects zero vectors. Bray-Curtis requires nonnegative values and rejects zero/zero pairs. Jaccard requires numeric binary indicators and defines empty/empty dissimilarity as zero.

contract.name: ParseNewickTreeDistances
contract.description: Parse a bounded named-tip Newick tree and compute named-tip patristic distances from strictly positive finite branch lengths on every nonroot node, rejecting missing ordinary lengths; absent/zero root stem only. These are distances on a supplied tree, not sequence phylogeny inference or temporal divergence estimates.

parameters.name: newick_text
parameters.description: Exactly one semicolon-terminated explicitly parenthesized Newick tree. Restricted ASCII labels [A-Za-z0-9_.-]+ only; no quoted labels, comments or inferred confidence. Every nonroot edge must have an explicit strictly positive finite representable float64 length; root stem absent or mathematically zero (nonzero lexical underflow is rejected). Internal nodes have at least2children; polytomies allowed. Unique exact labelled tips2..100, totalnodes<=200, depth<=100. Whitespace is accepted only between grammar tokens, not inside labels or numeric literals. No filesystem or network access.

contract.name: PeriodicNeighborList
contract.description:
Return all directed periodic geometric neighbors in a finite radius.

CIF fractional positions are preserved without rational-coordinate snapping.

Args:
    structure_file: Explicitly uploaded ordered crystal file, same public
        allowlist and10MiB source limit as the other crystal primitives.
    cutoff_angstrom: Finite positive Cartesian radius<=10angstrom. Search
        uses pymatgen's periodic neighbor algorithm, including image shifts
        beyond[-1,1] when required by an oblique cell. At most256 source
        sites and10000 returned directed edges; estimated candidate work
        N²*product(2*ceil((cutoff+1e-8)/h_i)+3) must be<=1000000,where h_i
        are perpendicular cell heights. Excess work/edges reject the whole
        call before return; results are never truncated to the edge limit.

Returns:
    dict with neighbors(list of unique edge_id,center_index,neighbor_index,image_shift,
    distance_angstrom,displacement_angstrom),edge_count,source SHA/formula,
    species,cell_angstrom,cutoff_angstrom,boundary_tolerance_angstrom,
    candidate_pair_bound andscope. Cell vectors are rows. Displacement is
    r_neighbor+image_shift@cell-r_center (center to neighbor-image).
    The list is directed: reverse edges are retained,and same-atom nonzero
    images are valid neighbors. Only the exact self pair with zero image
    is removed; coincident distinct sites are not silently discarded.
    Distances<=cutoff+1e-8angstrom are included. No chemical bonding,
    coordination-shell,oxidation-state or nearest-neighbor interpretation.

Raises:
    ValueError: Unsupported type/radius,disorder,too many sites or images,
        near-singular/nonfinite cell,nonfinite or abs>1e6 fractional
        coordinates,numerical failure or>10000 edges.

parameters.name: structure_file
parameters.description: Explicit existing periodic structure file path or task attachment name.

contract.name: PowderDiffractionPattern
contract.description:
Compute one ideal powder X-ray pattern from an ordered public structure.

CIF fractional positions are preserved without rational-coordinate snapping.

Args:
    structure_file (str): Uploaded ordered structure file (CIF/POSCAR).
    wavelength_angstrom (float): Positive X-ray wavelength in [0.1,5] angstrom.
    two_theta_min_deg (float): Lower two-theta angle in [0,179) degrees.
    two_theta_max_deg (float): Upper two-theta angle above lower and <=179.

Returns:
    dict: Peak records (two_theta_deg, relative_intensity, d_spacing_angstrom,
        and Miller-index families), wavelength/range, source hash/formula and
        pymatgen version. Intensities are normalized to maximum100; a valid
        range with no reflections returns an empty peak list. This ideal
        kinematic calculation omits instrumental broadening and texture.

contract.name: ReadCrystalStructure
contract.description:
Parse one periodic crystal file into complete geometry, preserving the supplied cell and occupancies.

Returns the original parsed pymatgen Structure (cell/site coordinates/species/
occupancies), parser version and exact source byte hash. No primitive-cell
reduction, chemical-bond assignment, density or electronic property is inferred.
Explicit CIF fractional coordinates are preserved with frac_tolerance=0.

contract.name: RedundancyReduction
contract.description: Greedy input-order representative selection using exact sequence equality or the declared pairwise identity threshold on canonical proteins. Output order/representative identity are part of the contract; this is not order-independent clustering, evolutionary homology or BLAST.

parameters.name: sequences
parameters.description: Between 1 and 100 canonical amino-acid string sequences. Whitespace/case are normalized and trailing stop symbols removed by the existing sequence contract. After normalization, each sequence supports at most 10000 residues only when identity_threshold equals 1 exactly; lower thresholds retain 2000. Strings only: bool, null and numeric substitutes fail. No input sequence is truncated or silently dropped.

parameters.name: identity_threshold
parameters.description: Numeric non-bool cutoff in (0,1], default 1. At exactly 1, normalized strings are compared for exact equality, with no alignment work. At every value below 1, use global-alignment identical nongap columns divided by all aligned columns including gaps. First qualifying representative wins, so nonexact greedy clustering can depend on input order.
